question: How many orders are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders_safe

question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers_safe

question: What is the average order value?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(total) FROM orders_safe

question: What is the highest order total?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(total) FROM orders_safe

question: How many products are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products_safe

question: How many orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders_safe WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: What is the price of the most expensive product?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(price) FROM products_safe

question: How many customers are in India?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers_safe WHERE country = 'India'

question: Number of customers per country
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers_safe GROUP BY country

question: Order count by status
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders_safe GROUP BY status

question: Total revenue by region
gold_sql: SELECT region, SUM(total) FROM orders_safe GROUP BY region

question: Average order value by region
gold_sql: SELECT region, AVG(total) FROM orders_safe GROUP BY region

question: How many products are in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products_safe GROUP BY category

question: How many customers are in each region?
gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM customers_safe GROUP BY region

question: Average product price by category
gold_sql: SELECT category, AVG(price) FROM products_safe GROUP BY category

question: Order count by region and status
gold_sql: SELECT region, status, COUNT(*) FROM orders_safe GROUP BY region, status

question: What is the maximum order total in each region?
gold_sql: SELECT region, MAX(total) FROM orders_safe GROUP BY region

question: Revenue by product category
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items_safe oi JOIN products_safe p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category

question: Top 3 product categories by units sold
gold_sql: SELECT p.category FROM order_items_safe oi JOIN products_safe p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Average order value by customer country
gold_sql: SELECT c.country, AVG(o.total) FROM orders_safe o JOIN customers_safe c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country

question: How many customers have placed more than 6 orders?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders_safe GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 6) t

question: Revenue by region for the Electronics category
gold_sql: SELECT o.region, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items_safe oi JOIN orders_safe o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products_safe p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY o.region

question: Top 5 customer IDs by total spend
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id FROM orders_safe GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY SUM(total) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Number of orders per customer country
gold_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) FROM orders_safe o JOIN customers_safe c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country

question: Which product has the highest total revenue? Give only the product name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items_safe oi JOIN products_safe p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Total revenue from orders placed by customers in Germany
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.total) FROM orders_safe o JOIN customers_safe c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Germany'

question: Monthly order count for 2025
gold_sql: SELECT MONTH(order_date), COUNT(*) FROM orders_safe WHERE YEAR(order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY MONTH(order_date)

question: Total revenue in 2025
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM orders_safe WHERE YEAR(order_date) = 2025

question: Quarterly order counts for 2025
gold_sql: SELECT QUARTER(order_date), COUNT(*) FROM orders_safe WHERE YEAR(order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY QUARTER(order_date)

question: Total revenue by year
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(order_date), SUM(total) FROM orders_safe GROUP BY YEAR(order_date)

question: How many customers signed up in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers_safe WHERE YEAR(signup_date) = 2024

question: Customers who signed up in 2024, by region
gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM customers_safe WHERE YEAR(signup_date) = 2024 GROUP BY region

question: Which month of 2025 had the highest revenue? Give the month number.
gold_sql: SELECT MONTH(order_date) FROM orders_safe WHERE YEAR(order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY MONTH(order_date) ORDER BY SUM(total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were placed in the second half of 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders_safe WHERE order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31'

question: Total revenue by region and year for 2025 and 2026
gold_sql: SELECT region, YEAR(order_date), SUM(total) FROM orders_safe WHERE YEAR(order_date) IN (2025, 2026) GROUP BY region, YEAR(order_date)

question: How many customers have placed at least one refunded order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders_safe WHERE status = 'refunded'

question: What percentage of orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders_safe), 2) FROM orders_safe WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: What is the total number of units sold?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items_safe

question: How many orders have a total above 1000?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders_safe WHERE total > 1000

question: What is the average order value for completed orders?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(total) FROM orders_safe WHERE status = 'completed'
